hook: Lucia found the safe by turning the music up. Jason thought she was crazy.
script: Lucia found the safe by turning the music up. Jason thought she was crazy. They had stolen its combination, but someone had moved the safe. Their overdue cut was inside. Behind the DJ booth stood eight identical speaker cabinets. Jason reached for a crowbar. Lucia pointed at the ceiling camera. Smash one cabinet, wake the owner. They had thirty seconds before his next round. Lucia pushed the bass. Seven grilles shook. On the eighth, a paper umbrella did not move. Jason felt behind that cabinet. No cable. He lifted the grille while Lucia watched the stairwell through a mirror. Inside waited the safe. Jason dialed their stolen numbers and took exactly the envelope marked JL. Lucia dropped the volume. Seven speakers fell silent. The eighth had been keeping their money quiet all week.
